title: Disaster Assistance Finder – Privacy Collection Notice
summary: This notice explains what personal information Service NSW collects when you use the Disaster Assistance Finder tool.
what_you_need: The type of disaster impacting you
How the disaster has impacted you
Whether you are of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander origin

faqs.a: Service NSW collects the type of disaster impacting you, how the disaster has impacted you, whether you are of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander origin, your email address, full name, phone number, and residential address.

faqs.q: How will my personal information be used?
faqs.a: The information is used to provide you with personalized results on eligible assistance, to email a link to your results, and if you book an appointment, staff may use it to provide further information on eligible assistance.

faqs.q: Do I have to provide this information?
faqs.a: You are required to provide this information if you want personalized recommendations or further information on the types of assistance for which you may be eligible.
